description: This file defines an interface 'Zend_Loader_PluginLoader_Interface' for plugin class loaders in the Zend Framework. It specifies methods for managing plugin class prefix paths, checking if a plugin is loaded, retrieving class names, and loading plugins.

classes.name: Zend_Loader_PluginLoader_Interface
classes.description: Interface for plugin class loader, defining methods for managing plugin paths, checking loaded plugins, and loading plugins.

methods.name: addPrefixPath
methods.description: Adds a prefixed path to the plugin loader registry.

methods.name: removePrefixPath
methods.description: Removes a prefix or prefixed path from the registry.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a plugin with the given name is loaded.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name for a plugin by its name.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a plugin by its name.
